heroHeadline: Tanker Struck by Projectile Entering Strait of Hormuz as Weekend Transits Collapse to 17 Vessels
heroSubtitle: Two crew were injured Monday after an unidentified projectile hit an inbound tanker, as Brent crude fell to $101.61 a barrel and shipping data showed weekend transits through the strait nearly halving week-on-week, from 37 vessels to 17
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports (FAO, World Bank, IMF, IEA, WFP), major outlets (Reuters, Bloomberg, Al Jazeera, CNBC), and institutional analyses (Lloyd's List, S&P Global, IFPRI, Atlantic Council).
